## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility/recovery implications.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and remaining unverified behavior. For UI changes, include reviewed screenshots made from generated fixtures.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused; meaningful behavior changes have regression coverage.
- [ ] Relevant tests/typecheck/build passed; skipped checks are explained above.
- [ ] No credentials, keys, sessions, databases, private backups, personal data, or unreviewed logs/screenshots are included.
- [ ] Storage/auth changes preserve integrity, interruption recovery, and access control.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated when affected.

Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md before opening a public pull request.
